about: Experience the beginning of The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon in the free Story Demo.
*PS4 demo save data can be transferred to the full PS4 or PS5 game upon its release.
*PS5 demo save data can be transferred to the full PS5 game upon its release.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
summary: Experience the beginning of The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon in the free Story Demo.
